Slide 8–10

Typical Multicore Processor

Multiple processors operating with coherent view of memory

Out-of-Order Processor Structure — (Instruction Control: Instruction Cache, Instruction Decoder, Registers, Op. Queue · Functional Units: Int Arith, Int Arith, FP Arith, Load / Store · Data Cache) · Instruction control dynamically converts program into stream of operations · Operations mapped onto functional units to execute in parallel

Hyperthreading Implementation

Replicate instruction control to process K instruction streams. · K copies of all registers. (Typically K=2) · Share functional units

多核处理器: 每个核有自己的寄存器、L1 和 L2 缓存, 所有核共享 L3 和主存; 多个处理器看到的是一致的内存视图 (硬件保证缓存一致性, 见下).

回顾第 15 讲的乱序处理器: 指令控制部分把程序动态地转换成操作流, 分派到多个功能单元并行执行. 但单个线程往往填不满所有功能单元. 超线程 (同时多线程) 的做法: 把指令控制部分复制 K 份 (通常 K = 2), 包括全套寄存器和 PC, 共享功能单元. 一个核就能同时执行两个线程的指令, 一个线程等内存时另一个可以用空闲的功能单元.

Slide 11–12

Benchmark Machine — Get data about machine from /proc/cpuinfo · Shark Machines · Intel Xeon E5520 @ 2.27 GHz · Nehalem, ca. 2010 · 8 Cores · Each can do 2-way hyperthreading

Exploiting parallel execution — So far, we've used threads to deal with I/O delays · e.g., one thread per client to prevent one from delaying another · Multi-core CPUs offer another opportunity · Spread work over threads executing in parallel on P cores · Happens automatically, if many independent tasks · e.g., running many applications or serving many clients · Can also write code to make one big task go faster · by organizing it as multiple parallel sub-tasks · Shark machines can execute 16 threads at once · 8 cores, each with 2-way hyperthreading · Theoretical speedup of 16X · never achieved in our benchmarks

测试机器: 课程的 Shark 机器, Intel Xeon E5520 (Nehalem 架构, 约 2010 年), 8 个核 (两颗四核处理器), 每核 2 路超线程, 可同时执行 16 个线程, 理论加速比 16 倍, 但在下面的测试中从未达到.

到目前为止, 线程是用来应对 I/O 延迟的 (每个客户一个线程, 互不拖累). 多核带来另一个机会: 把工作分给在 P 个核上并行执行的线程. 如果本来就有很多独立任务 (运行多个程序、服务多个客户), 这会自动发生; 也可以主动把一个大任务组织成多个并行子任务, 让它更快完成, 这是本讲的主题.

内存一致性
Consistency Models

Slide 13–14

Memory Coherence / Consistency

int a = 1;
int b = 100;

Thread1:            Thread2:
Wa: a = 2;          Wb: b = 200;
Rb: print(b);       Ra: print(a);

(Thread consistency constraints: Wa → Rb · Wb → Ra) · What are the possible values printed? · Depends on memory consistency model · Abstract model of how hardware handles concurrent accesses · How do the two threads really see the writes?

Non-Coherent Cache Scenario — Write-back caches, without coordination between them · (Thread1 Cache: a: 2, b:100 → print 100 · Thread2 Cache: a:1, b:200 → print 1 · Main Memory: a:1 b:100) · At later points, a=2 and b=200 are written back to main memory

例子: a 初值 1, b 初值 100. 线程 1 先写 a = 2 再打印 b; 线程 2 先写 b = 200 再打印 a. 每个线程内部有顺序约束: Wa 在 Rb 之前, Wb 在 Ra 之前. 可能打印出哪些值? 取决于内存一致性模型, 即硬件如何处理并发访问的抽象模型.

若各核的写回缓存之间毫无协调 (不一致的缓存): 线程 1 在自己的缓存里写 a = 2, 读到自己缓存中的 b = 100; 线程 2 写 b = 200, 读到 a = 1. 打印 100 和 1, 两个线程都没看到对方的写. 写入要到以后写回主存时才可见.

Slide 15–16

Snoopy Caches — Tag each cache block with state · Invalid: Cannot use value · Shared: Readable copy · Modified: Writeable copy · (After Wa and Wb: Thread1 cache M a: 2 · Thread2 cache M b:200 · Main memory a:1 b:100)

When cache sees request for one of its M-tagged blocks · Supply value from cache (Note: value in memory may be stale) · Set tag to S

窥探缓存 (snoopy caches) 保证一致性: 每个缓存块带一个状态: I 无效 (不能用)、S 共享 (只读副本, 可以有多份)、M 已修改 (可写副本, 全系统只有一份). 写之前要先让其他缓存中的副本失效, 拿到 M 状态. 每个缓存「窥探」总线上的请求: 看到别人要读自己处于 M 状态的块, 就直接从缓存提供最新值 (主存里的值可能已过时), 并把状态降为 S. 于是线程 1 读 b 得到 200, 线程 2 读 a 得到 2. 这就是常说的 MSI 协议 (实际处理器用它的扩展, 如 MESI).

Slide 17–19

Memory Consistency — What are the possible values printed? · Depends on memory consistency model · Sequential consistency · As if only one operation at a time, in an order consistent with the order of operations within each thread · Thus, overall effect consistent with each individual thread but otherwise allows an arbitrary interleaving

Sequential Consistency Example

Impossible outputs · 100, 1 and 1, 100 · Would require reaching both Ra and Rb before either Wa or Wb

顺序一致性: 效果如同所有操作一次执行一个, 顺序与每个线程内部的顺序一致, 线程之间可以任意交错. 列出全部 6 种交错, 输出 (按打印的先后) 有 100,2、200,2、2,200、1,200 这几种. 不可能的输出是 100 和 1 同时出现 (不论先后): 那要求 Ra 和 Rb 都发生在 Wa 和 Wb 之前, 而每个线程都是先写后读, 矛盾.

Slide 20–22

Non-Coherent Cache Scenario — Sequentially consistent? No!

Non-Sequentially Consistent Scenario — Coherent caches, but thread consistency constraints violated due to operation reordering · (order of execution: 1 Ra: print(a) → 1 · 2 Rb: print(b) → 100 · 3 Wa: a = 2 · 4 Wb: b = 200) · Architecture allows reads to finish before writes because single thread accesses different memory locations

Why Reordered? Writes take long time. Buffer write, let read go ahead. Instruction-level parallelism · Fix: Add SFENCE instructions between Wa & Rb and Wb & Ra · Fix: Use synchronization (properly written, it fences)

Memory Models — Sequentially Consistent: · Each thread executes in proper order, any interleaving · To ensure, requires · Proper cache/memory behavior · Proper intra-thread ordering constraints · Thread ordering constraints · Use synchronization to ensure the program is free of data races

不一致的缓存会打印出 100 和 1, 显然不是顺序一致的. 更令人意外的是: 即使缓存是一致的, 现代处理器也可能打印 100 和 1. 原因是写缓冲: 写入很慢, 处理器先把写放进写缓冲区, 让后面的读先执行 (指令级并行); 对单个线程来说, 读和写访问的是不同地址, 先读后写不影响结果, 所以硬件允许. 但两个线程都这样做, 读都跑到了写前面, 就违反了线程内的顺序约束. x86 的内存模型 (TSO) 正是允许「后面的读越过前面的写».

修复: 在写和读之间插入内存屏障指令; 或者使用同步原语, 正确实现的锁等原语内部带有屏障. 一般原则: 用同步确保程序没有数据竞争, 这样程序的行为就如同顺序一致.

幻灯片错误: "Fix: Add SFENCE instructions" 不对. x86 的 SFENCE 只保证屏障前后的写与写之间的顺序, 不能阻止后面的读越过前面的写; 要禁止这种「写-读」重排, 需要 MFENCE (或带 lock 前缀的指令, 如 xchg). 教材 12.6 节没有这句话, 课件此处属于笔误.

线程级并行: 并行求和
Thread-Level Parallelism: Parallel summation

Slide 25–29

Summation Example — Sum numbers 0, …, N-1 · Should add up to (N-1)*N/2 · Partition into K ranges · N/K values each · Each of the t threads processes 1 range · Accumulate leftover values serially · Method #1: All threads update single global variable · 1A: No synchronization · 1B: Synchronize with pthread semaphore · 1C: Synchronize with pthread mutex · “Binary” semaphore. Only values 0 & 1

typedef unsigned long data_t;
/* Single accumulator */
volatile data_t global_sum;

/* Mutex & semaphore for global sum */
sem_t semaphore;
pthread_mutex_t mutex;

/* Number of elements summed by each thread */
size_t nelems_per_thread;

/* Keep track of thread IDs */
pthread_t tid[MAXTHREADS];

/* Identify each thread */
int myid[MAXTHREADS];
nelems_per_thread = nelems / nthreads;

/* Set global value */
global_sum = 0;

/* Create threads and wait for them to finish */
for (i = 0; i < nthreads; i++) {
    myid[i] = i;
    Pthread_create(&tid[i], NULL, thread_fun, &myid[i]);
}
for (i = 0; i < nthreads; i++)
    Pthread_join(tid[i], NULL);

result = global_sum;

/* Add leftover elements */
for (e = nthreads * nelems_per_thread; e < nelems; e++)
    result += e;

并行求和: 求 0 到 N−1 之和, 应等于 (N−1)N/2. 把范围分成若干段, 每段 N/t 个数, 每个线程处理一段; 除不尽的剩余部分最后串行加上. 方法 1: 所有线程都更新同一个全局变量 global_sum: 1A 不同步; 1B 用信号量同步; 1C 用互斥锁同步 (二元信号量, 只取 0 和 1).

主程序: 算出每个线程的元素个数, global_sum 清零; 创建 nthreads 个线程, 参数是全局数组 myid 中各自那一项的地址 (上一讲的「唯一指针」方法); join 全部线程; 取出结果, 再加上剩余元素.

Slide 30–31

Thread Function: No Synchronization

void *sum_race(void *vargp)
{
    int myid = *((int *)vargp);
    size_t start = myid * nelems_per_thread;
    size_t end = start + nelems_per_thread;
    size_t i;

    for (i = start; i < end; i++) {
        global_sum += i;
    }
    return NULL;
}

Unsynchronized Performance — (chart “Parallel Sums #1”: elapsed seconds vs. threads 1–16, Race) · N = 230 · Best speedup = 2.86X · Gets wrong answer when > 1 thread! Why?

1A 不同步: 每个线程直接 global_sum += i. N = 230, 单线程约 2.5 秒, 最好的加速比只有 2.86 倍, 而且线程数大于 1 时结果就是错的: global_sum += i 是「读、加、写», 多个线程交错时互相覆盖 (上一讲的数据竞争). 加速比低的原因是所有线程都在争抢同一个缓存块 (真共享).

Slide 32–33

Thread Function: Semaphore / Mutex

/* Semaphore */
void *sum_sem(void *vargp)
{
    int myid = *((int *)vargp);
    size_t start = myid * nelems_per_thread;
    size_t end = start + nelems_per_thread;
    size_t i;

    for (i = start; i < end; i++) {
        sem_wait(&semaphore);
        global_sum += i;
        sem_post(&semaphore);
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* Mutex */
        pthread_mutex_lock(&mutex);
        global_sum += i;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&mutex);

Semaphore / Mutex Performance

Terrible Performance · 2.5 seconds → ~10 minutes · Mutex 3X faster than semaphore · Clearly, neither is successful · What is main reason for poor performance?

1B、1C: 每次加法前后都加锁解锁 (信号量或互斥锁). 结果正确了, 但性能糟糕: 从 2.5 秒变成约 10 分钟, 互斥锁比信号量快 3 倍, 但都完全失败. 主要原因: 同步操作本身很贵 (每次都是原子指令加上核之间争抢同一个锁和同一个缓存块), 而循环体里真正的工作只有一次加法, 同步开销是它的成百上千倍. 规律: 最内层循环里不能有同步.

Slide 34–36

Separate Accumulation — Method #2: Each thread accumulates into separate variable · 2A: Accumulate in contiguous array elements · 2B: Accumulate in spaced-apart array elements · 2C: Accumulate in registers

/* Partial sum computed by each thread */
data_t psum[MAXTHREADS*MAXSPACING];

/* Spacing between accumulators */
size_t spacing = 1;
nelems_per_thread = nelems / nthreads;

/* Create threads and wait for them to finish */
for (i = 0; i < nthreads; i++) {
    myid[i] = i;
    psum[i*spacing] = 0;
    Pthread_create(&tid[i], NULL, thread_fun, &myid[i]);
}
for (i = 0; i < nthreads; i++)
    Pthread_join(tid[i], NULL);

result = 0;
/* Add up the partial sums computed by each thread */
for (i = 0; i < nthreads; i++)
    result += psum[i*spacing];

/* Add leftover elements */
for (e = nthreads * nelems_per_thread; e < nelems; e++)
    result += e;

Thread Function: Memory Accumulation — Where is the mutex?

void *sum_global(void *vargp)
{
    int myid = *((int *)vargp);
    size_t start = myid * nelems_per_thread;
    size_t end = start + nelems_per_thread;
    size_t i;

    size_t index = myid*spacing;
    psum[index] = 0;
    for (i = start; i < end; i++) {
        psum[index] += i;
    }
    return NULL;
}

方法 2: 每个线程累加到自己的变量 psum[myid*spacing] 里, 最后由主线程把部分和加起来. 2A: 各线程的累加器在数组中紧挨着 (spacing = 1); 2B: 相隔 spacing 个元素; 2C: 在寄存器 (局部变量) 里累加.

「互斥锁在哪?» 不需要: 每个线程只写自己的那一项, 没有两个线程写同一个变量, 主线程在 join 之后才读, 不存在数据竞争.

Slide 37–39

Memory Accumulation Performance

Clear threading advantage · Adjacent speedup: 5 X · Spaced-apart speedup: 13.3 X (Only observed speedup > 8) · Why does spacing the accumulators apart matter?

False Sharing: Different Bytes but Same Cache Block

Coherence maintained on cache blocks · To update psum[i], thread i must have exclusive access · Threads sharing common cache block will keep fighting each other for access to block · Contrasts with True Sharing = same bytes being shared

False Sharing Performance — (chart “False Sharing Effects”: spacing 1, 2, 4, 8, 16) · Best spaced-apart performance 2.8 X better than best adjacent · Demonstrates cache block size = 64 · 8-byte values · No benefit increasing spacing beyond 8

分开累加有明显的并行优势: 相邻累加器加速 5 倍; 把累加器分开放, 加速 13.3 倍 (唯一超过 8 倍的结果, 说明超线程起了作用). 为什么间隔有影响? 伪共享: 缓存一致性以缓存块为单位维护. 8 个相邻的 8 字节累加器挤在同一个 64 字节的块里; 线程 i 要更新 psum[i], 必须独占整个块, 于是各线程虽然写的是不同字节, 却不停地争夺同一个块, 块在各核之间来回传递. 与之对比, 真共享是多个线程访问相同的字节.

间隔实验: 间隔为 1、2、4、8、16 时, 最好的分开版本比最好的相邻版本快 2.8 倍; 间隔达到 8 之后不再改善. 这正说明缓存块大小是 64 字节: 8 个 8 字节的值占满一块, 间隔 8 时每个累加器独占一块.

Slide 41–43

Thread Function: Register Accumulation

void *sum_local(void *vargp)
{
    int myid = *((int *)vargp);
    size_t start = myid * nelems_per_thread;
    size_t end = start + nelems_per_thread;
    size_t i;
    size_t index = myid*spacing;
    data_t sum = 0;
    for (i = start; i < end; i++) {
        sum += i;
    }
    psum[index] = sum;
    return NULL;
}

Register Accumulation Performance

Clear threading advantage · Speedup = 7.5 X · Beware the speedup metric! · 2X better than fastest memory accumulation

Lessons learned — Sharing memory can be expensive · Pay attention to true sharing · Pay attention to false sharing · Use registers whenever possible · (Remember cachelab) · Use local cache whenever possible · Deal with leftovers · When examining performance, compare to best possible sequential implementation

2C: 在局部变量 sum (寄存器) 中累加, 最后只写一次 psum. 加速比「只有」7.5 倍, 比内存累加的 13.3 倍小, 但绝对速度是最快内存累加的 2 倍. 「当心加速比这个指标»: 加速比是相对于本方法的单线程版本算的; 寄存器版本的单线程本身就快得多 (约 0.8 秒对 2.5 秒), 所以比值较小. 评价性能时要和最好的串行实现比.

教训: 共享内存代价可能很高, 要注意真共享和伪共享; 尽量用寄存器 (回想 cache lab), 尽量用本地缓存; 处理好剩余部分; 评价性能时与最好的串行实现比较.

分治并行: 并行快速排序
Divide-and-conquer parallelism: Parallel quicksort

Slide 44–47

A More Substantial Example: Sort — Sort set of N random numbers · Multiple possible algorithms · Use parallel version of quicksort · Sequential quicksort of set of values X · Choose “pivot” p from X · Rearrange X into · L: Values ≤ p · R: Values ≥ p · Recursively sort L to get L′ · Recursively sort R to get R′ · Return L′ : p : R′

Sequential Quicksort Visualized — (X → L p R → L2 p2 R2 → … → L′ · then R → L3 p3 R3 → … → R′ · L′ p R′)

Sequential Quicksort Code

void qsort_serial(data_t *base, size_t nele) {
    if (nele <= 1)
        return;
    if (nele == 2) {
        if (base[0] > base[1])
            swap(base, base+1);
        return;
    }

    /* Partition returns index of pivot */
    size_t m = partition(base, nele);
    if (m > 1)
        qsort_serial(base, m);
    if (nele-1 > m+1)
        qsort_serial(base+m+1, nele-m-1);
}

Sort nele elements starting at base · Recursively sort L or R if has more than one element

更实际的例子: 对 N 个随机数排序, 用快速排序的并行版本. 串行快排: 从 X 中选一个枢轴 p, 把 X 重排成 L (≤ p 的值)、p、R (≥ p 的值); 递归排序 L 和 R; 结果是 L′ : p : R′. 代码: 0、1 个元素直接返回, 2 个元素必要时交换; 否则 partition 返回枢轴的下标 m, 左边 m 个元素、右边 nele − m − 1 个元素, 只有多于一个元素时才递归.

Slide 48–49

Parallel Quicksort — Parallel quicksort of set of values X · If N ≤ Nthresh, do sequential quicksort · Else · Choose “pivot” p from X · Rearrange X into · L: Values ≤ p · R: Values ≥ p · Recursively spawn separate threads · Sort L to get L′ · Sort R to get R′ · Return L′ : p : R′

并行快排: 元素个数不超过阈值 Nthresh 就串行排序; 否则选枢轴、划分, 然后为 L 和 R 各派生一个线程递归排序. 因为 L 和 R 是数组中不相交的两段, 两个线程互不干扰, 不需要任何同步, 典型的分治并行.

Slide 50–51

Parallel Quicksort Performance

Serial fraction: Fraction of input at which do serial sort · Sort 227 (134,217,728) random values · Best speedup = 6.84X · Good performance over wide range of fraction values · F too small: Not enough parallelism · F too large: Thread overhead too high

对 227 = 134217728 个随机数排序. 参数「串行比例» F: 子数组小于输入的 1/F 时就改为串行排序 (Nthresh = N/F). 最好加速 6.84 倍, 在很宽的 F 范围内性能都不错. F 太小 (阈值太大): 很快就转成串行, 并行度不够; F 太大 (阈值太小): 创建的线程太多, 线程开销过高.

Slide 52–55

Amdahl's Law (Travel Analogy) — Flying jet non-stop from PIT -> LHR: 7.5 Hours (speed-up 1) · Or, old fashioned SST way: · Fly jet from PIT -> JFK: 1.5 Hours · Fly SST from JFK -> LHR: 3.5 Hours · 5 Hours (1.5x) · Or, Using FTL: · Fly jet from PIT -> JFK: 1.5 Hours · Fly FTL from JFK -> LHR: .01 Hours · 1.51 Hours (~5x) · Best possible speed up is 5X, even with FTL because have to get to New York. · T=7.5, p=6/7.5=.8, k= ∞ ⇒ T∞ = (1-p)T=1.5 max speed-up =5x

Amdahl's Law — Overall problem · T Total sequential time required · p Fraction of total that can be sped up (0 ≤ p ≤ 1) · k Speedup factor · Resulting Performance · Tk = pT/k + (1-p)T · Portion which can be sped up runs k times faster · Portion which cannot be sped up stays the same · Maximum possible speedup · k=∞ · T∞ = (1-p)T

Amdahl's Law Example — T = 10 Total time required · p = 0.9 Fraction of total which can be sped up · k=9 Speedup factor · T9 = 0.9 * 10/9 + 0.1 * 10 = 1.0 + 1.0 = 2.0 (a 5x speedup) · T∞ = 0.1 * 10.0 = 1.0 (a 10x speedup) · With infinite parallel computing resources! · Limit speedup shows algorithmic limitation

Amdahl 定律: 总时间 T, 其中比例 p 的部分能被加速 k 倍, 其余不变, 则

Tk​=kpT​+(1−p)T,T∞​=(1−p)T,

最大加速比是 1/(1−p). 旅行的比喻: 匹兹堡 (PIT) 直飞伦敦 (LHR) 7.5 小时; 先坐 1.5 小时飞到纽约 (JFK), 再坐超音速客机 (SST) 3.5 小时, 共 5 小时, 1.5 倍; 即使从纽约到伦敦用超光速 (FTL) 只要 0.01 小时, 总共 1.51 小时, 也只有约 5 倍, 因为总得先飞到纽约. 这里 p = 6/7.5 = 0.8, 最大加速比 1/0.2 = 5.

例: T = 10, p = 0.9, k = 9: T9 = 1 + 1 = 2, 加速 5 倍; 资源无限时 T∞ = 1, 最多 10 倍. 这个上限反映的是算法本身的串行部分, 加再多处理器也没用.

Slide 56–57

Amdahl's Law & Parallel Quicksort — Sequential bottleneck · Top-level partition: No speedup · Second level: ≤ 2X speedup · kth level: ≤ 2k-1X speedup · Implications · Good performance for small-scale parallelism · Would need to parallelize partitioning step to get large-scale parallelism · Parallel Sorting by Regular Sampling – H. Shi & J. Schaeffer, J. Parallel & Distributed Computing, 1992

Lessons Learned — Must have parallelization strategy · Partition into K independent parts · Divide-and-conquer · Inner loops must be synchronization free · Synchronization operations very expensive · Watch out for hardware artifacts · Need to understand processor & memory structure · True sharing and false sharing of global data · Beware of Amdahl's Law · Serial code can become bottleneck · You can do it! · Achieving modest levels of parallelism is not difficult · Set up experimental framework and test multiple strategies

用 Amdahl 定律看并行快排: 最顶层的划分只能由一个线程完成, 没有加速 (而它要扫描全部 N 个元素); 第二层最多 2 倍, 第 k 层最多 2k−1 倍. 所以小规模并行效果不错, 要大规模并行就必须把划分步骤本身也并行化 (例如正则采样并行排序).

总的教训: 要有并行化策略 (分成 K 个独立部分, 或分治); 内层循环中不能有同步, 同步非常贵; 当心硬件现象, 要理解处理器和内存结构, 注意全局数据的真共享和伪共享; 当心 Amdahl 定律, 串行代码会成为瓶颈. 达到中等程度的并行并不难: 搭好实验框架, 测试多种策略.

Slide 60–63

Powerful, Parallel Computing Is — Two threads, with X and Y initialized to 0

X = 1                         Y = 1
if (Y == 0) print Hello       if (X == 0) print World

Thread Structure: Sorting Tasks — Task: Sort subrange of data · Specify as: · base: Starting address · nele: Number of elements in subrange · Run as separate thread

Small Sort Task Operation — Sort subrange using serial quicksort · Large Sort Task Operation — Partition Subrange · Spawn 2 tasks

补充幻灯片. 标题是一句双关 (配蜘蛛侠图: 「能力越大, 责任越大»). X、Y 初值 0, 两个线程各写一个、读另一个. 在顺序一致的模型下, 至少有一个线程能看到对方的写, 所以不会同时打印 Hello 和 World; 但正如第 21–22 页所说, 写缓冲允许读越过写, 两个线程可能都读到 0, 于是 Hello 和 World 都被打印. 这正是上面一致性例子的另一种形式.

并行快排的线程结构: 一个任务就是排序一个子区间 (起始地址 base、元素个数 nele), 作为一个单独的线程运行. 小任务直接串行快排; 大任务先划分子区间, 再派生两个新任务.

Slide 64–66

Top-Level Function (Simplified)

void tqsort(data_t *base, size_t nele) {
    init_task(nele);
    global_base = base;
    global_end = global_base + nele - 1;
    task_queue_ptr tq = new_task_queue();
    tqsort_helper(base, nele, tq);
    join_tasks(tq);
    free_task_queue(tq);
}

Sets up data structures · Calls recursive sort routine · Keeps joining threads until none left · Frees data structures

Recursive sort routine (Simplified)

/* Multi-threaded quicksort */
static void tqsort_helper(data_t *base, size_t nele,
                          task_queue_ptr tq) {
    if (nele <= nele_max_sort_serial) {
        /* Use sequential sort */
        qsort_serial(base, nele);
        return;
    }
    sort_task_t *t = new_task(base, nele, tq);
    spawn_task(tq, sort_thread, (void *) t);
}

Small partition: Sort serially · Large partition: Spawn new sort task

Sort task thread (Simplified)

/* Thread routine for many-threaded quicksort */
static void *sort_thread(void *vargp) {
    sort_task_t *t = (sort_task_t *) vargp;
    data_t *base = t->base;
    size_t nele = t->nele;
    task_queue_ptr tq = t->tq;
    free(vargp);
    size_t m = partition(base, nele);
    if (m > 1)
        tqsort_helper(base, m, tq);
    if (nele-1 > m+1)
        tqsort_helper(base+m+1, nele-m-1, tq);
    return NULL;
}

Get task parameters · Perform partitioning step · Call recursive sort routine on each partition (if size of part > 1)

代码 (简化版): 顶层函数 tqsort 建立任务队列, 调用递归函数, 然后不断 join 线程直到没有剩余任务, 最后释放数据结构. tqsort_helper: 区间小就串行排序; 否则把参数打包成一个 malloc 出来的任务结构, 派生一个新线程. 线程函数 sort_thread: 取出参数后 free 掉任务结构 (上一讲的「主线程分配、线程释放»), 划分, 然后对两边分别调用 tqsort_helper, 可能继续派生新线程. 因为线程是 join 而不是分离的, 由任务队列记下所有线程, 顶层统一回收.
